design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (testing_supply_program_services), frozen_time 2026-10-15 14:05:00 EDT.

1. DRAW AND SCOPE. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 4, 5]}. Taken: bgm_ext_courtesy_bridge_reship 6 (root), bgm_ext_payment_plan_installment 5, bgm_ext_hardship_cost_share_waiver 5, bgm_ext_noncovered_strip_charge 4. Occupied by task 0: the take-back, the above-coverage notice and the new-meter refill with tools issue_return_authorization_3dfb992f, sign_liability_notice_3f2fa265, ship_strip_refill_72890190. Claimed here, disjoint: ship_courtesy_reship_05d6f35c (bgm_replacement_shipment), accept_payment_plan_2bd91da1 (customer's own write; payment plan request governing bgm_patient_payment), post_noncovered_charge_41a38519 (bgm_patient_charge), post_hardship_waiver_f8410ea4 (bgm_balance_adjustment). Together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies; nothing is reserved.

2. WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer asks only for the strips that never reached her. The agent must find that a courtesy reship on an account carrying a past-due amount is not shipped until an approved payment plan stands, that the plan's installment waits on the owed non-covered charge (the July ABN line Medicare denied under CO-151 with no supporting record on file) and on the owed hardship waiver (latest approved application), reconcile the Medicare remittances, an expedite charge, payments, a correction and two request records, read the CGM program's balance, regimen, sensor refills and hardship waiver, and compute four numbers in topological order.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root bgm_ext_courtesy_bridge_reship. Edges:
 - reship <- plan, state_gate, gate bgm_requests.request_status, form state. Sentence (negated, a release): "A courtesy reship for a program that carries a past-due amount is not shipped until an approved payment plan request stands on the program." Only accept_payment_plan_2bd91da1 writes an approved payment plan request. False at opening: past-due 70.16 (postings dated more than 120 days before 2026-10-15 = 255.24, less payments 178.28 and the 6.80 correction), below past_due_hold_min_usd 75, so no base hold is owed; the only plan request 6e52b03a-51d8-4bb6-9776-f85642fbe7f2 is withdrawn. Skipping it: reship value unchanged (4) but the DB lacks the plan row and 61.27 stays past due (terminal hash differs).
 - plan <- charge, value_input, gate program_balance, form state. Sentence (affirmative, a figure): "The monthly installment of a payment plan is fixed only after the program's latest claim denial, when it denies a strip claim line and is not appealed but handled as a non-covered amount under a signed liability notice, carries its non-covered item patient charge on the program." Only post_noncovered_charge_41a38519 writes such a charge. False at opening: denial 83277000-3559-44f7-87ac-763effe76ac0 (CO-151, 2026-09-10) on the claim of refill eb444912-863c-4084-86ec-742a915742c3; no medical record with purpose over_limit_justification is on file (f4090dbc-e22b-4fff-a7be-9dac8614c3c8 is a continued-need note), so base routes it to the non-covered amount, not to appeal; ABN a6e51abb-7e81-4d6f-a7d7-ba8c156a298d for 4 units dated 2026-07-02; no non_covered_item charge. Skipping: the program's balance stays 99.93, below payment_plan_min_balance_usd 100.00, so no plan is offered (0 instead of 24.98).
 - plan <- waiver, value_input, gate program_balance, form state. Sentence ("Before ... must", affirmative): "Before the monthly installment of a payment plan is fixed, the posting named on the program's latest approved hardship application must carry its hardship waiver balance adjustment." Only post_hardship_waiver_f8410ea4 writes hardship_waiver adjustments. False at opening: 2d31ced6-abef-4e72-abc6-11f72f3043eb approved, naming b5a27f2e-97ae-48a8-a862-eb6cf43247bc, no hardship_waiver against it. Skipping: installment 27.20 instead of 24.98.
 Four-point test on each: explicit ordering connective; record-visible states; no tool, id or snake_case token; strength matches the condition. Order: charge and waiver (commute - the charge reads no adjustment, and the charge enters both terms of the waiver's cap; both orders give 19.12 / 8.89 / 24.98 / 4) -> plan -> reship.

4. FACTOR CARDS (factor-sensitivity figures; baseline_result = all at the fall-through).
 Charge (expected 19.12; baseline_result 74.00): concerned_units_route (method; remittance + CO-151 -> 9 - 6 = 3; baseline ABN units 4 -> 25.49); unit_price_basis (parameter; ABN tier with remittance -> 70.80/6 = 11.80; baseline billed 18.50 -> 29.97); posting_delay_share (parameter; 35 days -> 0.9; baseline -> 21.24); hardship_relief_share (parameter; approved 2026-09-22 -> 0.6; baseline -> 31.86). Priced only because the shipment is a strip refill, the code is CO-151 with no over_limit_justification record on file and the latest strip notice precedes the ship date (probes P1-P4). Near-miss: the January medical record is a continued-need note, not a quantity justification.
 Waiver (expected 8.89; baseline_result 39.36): waivable_basis (method; deductible 40.00 split -> 26.16; baseline 46.16 -> 18.07); payer_class_share (parameter; Original Medicare with one approved application in 12 months -> 0.75; baseline 1 -> 11.85); payment_effort_share (parameter; latest payment 2026-03-15, none within 6 months -> 0.8; baseline 1 -> 11.11); posting_age_share (parameter; 154 days -> 0.9; baseline -> 9.87); household_relief_share (parameter, cross-difficulty cgm; CGM waiver 30.00 of 2026-05-05 within 12 months, below 50 -> 0.85; baseline -> 10.45). Plain, not factors: every adjustment already posted against the posting is subtracted (6.80) and the cap min(46.16 - 6.80, balance less the other postings of the last 6 months) = 39.36. All baselines: (46.16 - 6.80) x 1 = 39.36, at the cap. Near-miss: the CGM program's own hardship application is not the program's.
 Plan (expected 24.98; baseline_result 20.00): plan_balance_scope (method; a charge posted in the last calendar month -> balance 119.05 less 19.12 = 99.93; baseline the whole balance -> 29.76); balance_band_months (parameter; 119.05 < 150 -> 2; baseline 10 months -> 20.00); prior_plan_record (parameter; withdrawn 2025-12-01 -> -1; baseline 0 -> 20.00); hardship_months_extension (parameter; approved 2026-09-22 -> +2; baseline 0 -> 49.96); household_months_extension (parameter, cross-difficulty cgm; active CGM balance 41.18 -> +1; baseline 0 -> 33.31). The minimum-balance test reads the program's own balance (119.05 >= 100.00), as bgm_evt_patient_account does. Near-miss: the July expedite charge of 24.50 is older than a calendar month.
 Reship (expected 4; baseline_result 1): bridge_shape (method; 70 days to the next refill -> those days instead of the 30-day block; baseline the 30-day block (+10 days) -> 3); bridge_day_convention (parameter, multi-source; recorded confirmation 2026-10-02 on a 90-day tier -> refill_ship_lead_days 10 added, 80 days covered; baseline 0 added -> 3); bridge_daily_rate (parameter; no over-limit record -> 300/90; baseline 100/90 -> 2); repeat_courtesy_share (parameter; 2025-04-30 reship -> 0.75; baseline -> 5); sensor_wear_share (parameter, cross-difficulty cgm; active with the 2026-09-30 sensor refill -> 0.6; baseline -> 5); fingerstick_reserve (parameter, cross-difficulty cgm; multiple_daily_injections on the open CGM program -> 30 strips; baseline 0 -> 3). Plain, not a factor: the reship ships expedited at no charge only for a refill Larkfield itself expedited at no charge, and standard otherwise (standard here, transit 7). (80 + 7) x 300/90 x 0.75 x 0.6 + 30 = 160.5 -> 4.
 Multi-source (every non-fall-through tier an and/or over distinct records): bridge_day_convention (the refill's recorded confirmation AND the tier's supply days), bridge_daily_rate (the over-limit record count AND the tier's high_utilization_record_months; the treatment class AND no such record) and waivable_basis (the named posting's type AND the tier's deductible or copay). Not multi-source: payer_class_share (its second tier is the tier alone), concerned_units_route (its second tier is the remittance alone), household_months_extension and household_relief_share (one value each). Cross-difficulty: household_relief_share (cgm_billing), household_months_extension (CGM balance), sensor_wear_share and fingerstick_reserve (CGM program and shipments).

5. FACTOR INDEPENDENCE AND METHOD TIERS. Independence (round 2 walker, deleted at hand-off): no factor binding reads another factor's binding, transitively, and `result` is in no factor; shared selections are plain bindings stated once (the denied claim and shipment, the class allowance units, the program balance, the counted adjustments and the waiver cap, the latest strip refill and its dates, the reship method and transit). Pairwise method tiers (distinguishing input, world value): concerned_units_route T1/T2 a remittance on the denied claim (3 vs 9), T1/T3 a CO-151 vs PR-204 code with a remittance (3 vs the ABN's 4), T2/T3 no remittance (9 vs 4); waivable_basis T1/T2 deductible tier vs copay tier (26.16 vs the HMO's min(amount, 35)), T1/T3 and T2/T3 the posting's whole amount (46.16); plan_balance_scope T1/T3 a charge in the last calendar month (99.93 vs 119.05), T2/T3 an aged balance with newer postings (opening world: aged 70.16 vs balance 108.82), T1/T2 newer postings besides the recent charge (99.93 vs aged 61.27); bridge_shape T1/T2 days to the next refill above 30 (4 vs 2 units for one block: 37 x 300/90 x 0.45 + 30 = 85.5), T1/T3 and T2/T3 the full refill (6). The parameter bridge_day_convention's tiers stay apart on their reachable domain: 0 vs refill_ship_lead_days on every 90-day tier (10), refill_contact_lead_days vs refill_ship_lead_days on the 30-day confirmation tiers (Commercial HMO 10 vs 7, Medicaid 14 vs 7); the self-pay tier records no confirmation and falls through. Round 5: bridge_day_convention now adds days to the days the reship covers (refill_ship_lead_days on a 90-day confirmed tier, refill_ship_lead_days less refill_contact_lead_days on a 30-day confirmed tier, none otherwise); its tiers stay apart on their reachable domain (10 vs 0 on every 90-day tier; HMO -3 and Medicaid -7 vs 0 on the 30-day confirmation tiers).

6. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Charge: notice_before_charge (ABN a6e51abb-7e81-4d6f-a7d7-ba8c156a298d signed 2026-07-02, on or before the 2026-07-06 ship date, item A4253, 4 units >= 3 charged); bgm_evt_denials_and_appeals routes the CO-151 denial to the non-covered amount because no medical record supporting the quantity is on file (dated on or before the date of service or otherwise), so no appeal is owed. Waiver: hardship_approved (2d31ced6-abef-4e72-abc6-11f72f3043eb approved, names b5a27f2e-97ae-48a8-a862-eb6cf43247bc; Original Medicare hardship_waiver_allowed true); never more than the posting's unpaid remainder (oldest-first payments 178.28 stop inside the 2026-02-10 posting, so b5a27f2e keeps 46.16 - 6.80 = 39.36; the policy's cap gives 39.36 and the waiver is 8.89); small_balance_ceiling (restricts small-balance write-offs; a hardship_waiver is not one; balance 127.94 before the waiver). Plan: bgm_evt_patient_account (payment_plan_max_months 10 > 0; the program's own balance 119.05 >= 100.00; 24.98 >= 20.00; no structured gate applies to bgm_patient_payment). Reship: courtesy_limit (courtesy reships within 12 months: 0 < 1; the 2025-04-30 one is 17 months old); damage_report_window (it governs damaged packages; this one was not damaged, and the report on day 6 after the 2026-10-09 POD would be inside it anyway); bgm_evt_quantity_limits (4 <= 6 units, not counted toward the allowance). Automatic clauses: past-due 70.16 is below past_due_hold_min_usd 75, so no past-due hold is owed; the program and the CGM program are active; the October refill's claim is pending within 365 days.

7. BUSINESS OBJECTS. Charge: shipment eb444912-863c-4084-86ec-742a915742c3 (9 units, shipped expedited at the customer's request), its claim, remittance (6 units allowed) and CO-151 denial; its 24.50 expedite charge is a separate charge type; earlier claims are fully adjudicated. Waiver: remittance b5a27f2e-97ae-48a8-a862-eb6cf43247bc named on the latest approved application 2d31ced6-abef-4e72-abc6-11f72f3043eb; other remittances are not named. Plan: the program's balance after both writes less the charge of the last calendar month. Reship: refill 2371e960-828d-4d46-9b4a-902f49aa88b5 (6 units, standard, confirmed 2026-10-02, shown delivered 2026-10-09 by carrier scan, not received).

8. PERSONA. Soft-spoken retired upholsterer; volunteers the missing October box and asks for it to be replaced. Given only when asked: name/phone, DOB/ZIP, email. Passive: accepts the July ABN charge if raised; confirms her hardship approval letter if mentioned; agrees to monthly payments if told the reship is held up by the account balance, and accepts the handed-over plan with the details read out; closes when told the replacement strips and box count are on the way. She never raises charges, waivers or plans herself.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION AND RUN. Reads: customer, verification, bgm program, coverage, orders, shipments, billing, requests, CGM program, orders, shipments, billing, requests. Writes: charge 19.12 against eb444912-863c-4084-86ec-742a915742c3 -> waiver 8.89 against b5a27f2e-97ae-48a8-a862-eb6cf43247bc -> customer accepts 4 x 24.98 -> courtesy reship 4 units standard against 2371e960-828d-4d46-9b4a-902f49aa88b5. The round-2 scratch evaluator (replicating check_compute; deleted at hand-off) printed G (19.12, {25.49, 29.97, 21.24, 31.86, ALL 74.0}), H (8.89, {18.07, 11.85, 11.11, 9.87, 10.45, ALL 39.36}), I (24.98, {29.76, 20.0, 20.0, 49.96, 33.31, ALL 20.0}), I without the charge 0 (no plan: balance 99.93 < 100), I without the waiver 27.2, F (4, {2, 3, 2, 5, 5, 3, ALL 1}; round 4), H after vs before the charge 8.89 / 8.89, the plan with the charge and waiver swapped 24.98; check_compute: COMPUTE OK.

10. EDGE PROBES (round 2; [charge, waiver, plan, reship] each on the opening world, before any write: [19.12, 8.89, 20.0, 4]): P1 an over_limit_justification record on file -> [0, 8.89, 20.0, 4] (CO-151 goes to appeal, nothing priced); P2 CO-50 -> [0, ...]; P3 decoy second notice signed 2026-10-01, after the ship date -> [0.0, ...] (the latest notice counts and fails the date); P4 decoy later denial on the 2025 meter claim -> [0, ...] (not a strip refill); P5 PR-204 with a remittance -> [25.49, ...] (the notice's 4 units); P6 decoy second approved hardship application of 2026-03-02 -> [19.12, 7.11, 20.0, 4] (the latest application's posting is waived; more than one in 12 months -> medicare_repeat_share 0.6); P7 a 100.00 payment on 2026-09-01 -> [19.12, 0.0, 0, 4] (oldest-first payments reach the named posting: cap 0; balance below 100: no plan); P8 no CGM holdings or ledgers (absent CFIELD/EXISTS/XSUM) -> [19.12, 10.45, 23.39, 5]; P9 Medicare Advantage tier -> [0, 18.07, 20.0, 4]; P10 self-pay tier -> [0, 0, 0, 6]; P11 the October refill without a recorded confirmation -> [.., .., .., 3] (no days added); P12 the denied shipment with 0 supply days -> [39.96, ...] (allowance 0: the remittance price is skipped, no division by 0); P13 no requests -> [31.86, 0.0, 23.39, 4] (no named posting: waiver 0); P14 no payments -> [19.12, 8.89, 31.05, 4]. Every DAYS call is guarded against an empty date, plan_months is at least 1, the deductible split guards coinsurance_pct 100, MONTHS reads only a present posting date.

11. OVERWRITES. Charge: retires in bgm_liability_notice only "charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned" (round 4: the denial words, which do not conflict, stay in force) for a strip charge this policy prices; the replaced_by names its own scope and keeps every other charge at the cash price. The charge now prices only denials bgm_evt_denials_and_appeals hands to the non-covered amount (CO-151 with no supporting record, PR-204) and leaves every other denial to the base route, so the base route is not departed from. Waiver, plan, reship: [] (the waiver carries the base cap "never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder" as a conservative cap; the plan tests the base minimum on the program's own balance; the bridge stays within the base cap on replacement units). No clause is retired twice in the charter (task 0 retires different clauses of bgm_evt_quantity_limits and bgm_evt_refill_shipment).

12. RULE <-> COMPUTE. Rounding "rounded to cents only at the end" -> RND(..., 2) on result only (charge, waiver), "rounded to cents" for the installment -> RND in result; "rounded up to a whole unit" -> ceil in the reship; "rounded down to whole units" -> // in the allowance units; windows "later than the same calendar day N months earlier" -> within_months; day counts -> DAYS; caps "never more than" -> MN; floors -> MX.

13. DRAFT FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published rules, the schemas, the persona and the finder returns: the past-due amount is above 0, so the plan precedes the reship; the plan waits on the charge (CO-151 under the July ABN, no supporting record) and the waiver (latest approved application); charge 3 x 11.80 x 0.9 x 0.6 = 19.12; waiver 19.36 x 0.75 x 0.8 x 0.9 x 0.85 = 8.89; plan (119.05 - 19.12)/4 = 24.98 over 4 months; reship 4 units standard. Same as gold.

14. REVISIONS. (r1) Frozen time moved from 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-15 so the reship's base damage-report window is literally met (POD 2026-10-09); the bridge parameters were re-searched (scratch search, deleted at hand-off) so that each of the six reship factors moves the units. (r2) The reship's baseline was then the base whole-package replacement (round 4 made it one 30-day block, see section 17); its earlier overwrite of the replacement cap was dropped because the bridge stays within that cap. (r3) The waiver's payer share now rests on a record count as well as the tier. (r4) Empty foreign-key fields were removed from seeded and tool-written requests (replay FK gate).


15. ROUND-2 REWORK (audit policy_task/testing_supply_program_services). C7: the charge prices only CO-151 denials with no over_limit_justification record on file and PR-204 denials, so the base denial route is kept; the 2026-01-08 record is a continued-need note in this world. C5: the notice that counts is the program's latest strip notice, and the charge is priced only when it precedes the ship date (rule and compute agree on the decoy). C8: the plan minimum is tested on the program's own balance; the CGM balance no longer enters the plan (household_coverage_scope and aged_first_payment, whose first payment had no field, are replaced by plan_balance_scope and household_months_extension); to keep the plan reachable the world gains the July expedite charge (24.50) and loses the 2026-06-20 payment (past-due 70.16, still below 75). C1: counted_adjustment_kinds struck (one sum), now a plain subtraction of every adjustment against the posting; payment_effort_share added. C3/C6: payer_class_share's fall-through names the commercial tiers and its Medicare tier covers zero or one applications. C9: the waiver carries the conservative remainder cap. C2: bridge_day_convention is a parameter (lead days 0 / contact / ship) whose 30-day tier differs from the fall-through on its reachable domain. C3: transit_allowance struck; the reship's own method follows the refill's and sets its transit days; fingerstick_reserve added. Seeded CGM chain re-dated to the CGM charter's order: remittance 7bad637c 2026-04-24 -> approved application 4cf9abf6 received 2026-04-28 -> hardship waiver c34d7447 30.00 posted 2026-05-05 (within the 41.18 remainder) -> payment e3b4b9dc 11.18 on 2026-05-11 (remainder 0). Persona plan branch no longer quotes the gate. Gold: 19.12 / 11.11 -> 8.89 / 4 x 22.13 -> 4 x 24.98 / 4 units standard (sensor share 0.6 and reserve 30 keep every factor and the cross reads load-bearing).

16. ROUND-3 REWORK (world and every computed value unchanged; re-checked: 19.12 / 8.89 / 24.98 / 4 with identical sensitivities). R2-2: the E5 sentence is narrowed to the program's latest claim denial, when it denies a strip claim line and is handled as a non-covered amount under a signed notice, and its condition says the same (any such denial, whichever code, routed by the base rules); the E5 effect now says the charge enters the balance read by the minimum-balance test and the band, and that a charge of the last calendar month is left out of the covered balance (O20). O18: the reship goes expedited at no charge only when the stood-in refill went expedited at no charge (standard here, so nothing moves). O19: the reship tool's shipping_method docstring carries no policy cue. Probes: unchanged (the narrowed sentence reads the same latest denial the charge reads).

17. ROUND-4 REWORK (render-source F1-F3, F5, F8; scored values unchanged: 19.12 / 8.89 / 24.98 / 4). F1: the hardship baseline no longer names the four shares; each share sentence states that it multiplies the waiver before the ceilings and the rounding (compute unchanged). F2: the courtesy reship's standard is now one 30-day block of strips plus transit at the non-insulin rate, rounded up; bridge_shape selects the days the reship covers (bridge days over 30 days to the next refill, every unit at 0 or fewer, the 30-day block otherwise), and result assembles cover days, transit, the strips a day, the two shares and the reserve, so no factor reads another (transitive read check OK, 33 factors); bridge_shape's baseline figure moves 6 -> 2 and baseline_result 6 -> 1, the scored 4 does not move. F3: the charge's overwrite retires only "charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned". F5: the prior-plan tiers date a request by when it was received and read its present status, as compute does (6e52b03a received 2025-12-01, withdrawn: tier 1 as before). F8: the Advance Beneficiary Notice price states that the claim's remittances must allow more than 0 and the allowance give at least one unit, and the billed-charge price is 0 for a shipment with no units (July claim: allowed 70.80, 6 units, as before). Probes for the changed reads (reship at handling time): the October refill dated 2026-08-05 (19 days to the next refill) reads the block tier -> 2 units (round 5: 3 units, the 10 confirmation days now added to the block as well); dated 2026-07-01 (the July refill becomes the latest, 0 or fewer days) reads every unit -> 9.

18. ROUND-5 REWORK (XF class and stale ladders; scored values unchanged: 19.12 / 8.89 / 24.98 / 4). Every policy now states, right after its standard method, one generic combination sentence (each rule below changes only the standard quantity it names; order stated generically; the standard limits and rounding last), and result / combination bindings quote it. Shared plain quantities sit in the standard paragraph: the balance (plan), the whole-calendar-months rule (waiver), the allowance units (charge), the reship's carriage and transit (reship). Courtesy reship: bridge_shape no longer reads the bridge days of bridge_day_convention; it replaces the days covered with the days until the next refill may ship, and bridge_day_convention adds days to the days covered (same 80 days here), so no factor sentence reads another factor's output; bridge_shape's baseline figure moves 2 -> 3. Ladders re-swept against the rules: unit_price_basis tiers 1 and 3 (R2-1), bridge_shape and bridge_day_convention rewritten; denial_posted is now a binding of posting_delay_share, the only factor reading it. Probes: refill dated 2026-08-05 (block) 3 units; 2026-07-01 (every unit) 9; no recorded confirmation 3; the same world on the Commercial HMO tier 5 (30-day confirmation tier, 3 days taken off).
user_scenario: You are Marguerite Vanterpool, a 76-year-old retired upholsterer in Coraopolis who has used insulin for years and wears a Dexcom G7 sensor. You are soft-spoken, a little embarrassed about money, and you tell things in order. You are calling Larkfield Medical Supply because the tracking for your October box of test strips says it was delivered on October 9, but it never reached you - it was not on your porch or in the building lobby - and you are nearly out of strips, so you would like the missing strips replaced. When the representative asks who you are, you give your name, Marguerite Vanterpool, and your phone number, 4125550162; to verify you, you give your date of birth, 1950-02-17, and your ZIP code, 15108; only if they ask for an email do you give m.vanterpool.weaves@ridgepost.net. If the representative brings up a charge for the extra strip boxes Medicare turned down from the July shipment, you remember signing the Medicare form for those extra boxes and you accept it is yours to pay. If they mention your hardship request, you say you received a letter in September saying it was approved. If the representative tells you the replacement is held up by the balance on your account, you say you cannot pay the whole balance at once on your pension, so you would like to pay it in monthly payments; when they hand the plan over to you to accept, you accept it with the details they read out. Regular shipping to your address on file is fine. Once the representative tells you the replacement strips are on their way and how many boxes are coming, you thank them and end the call.

request_alignment.claim: The customer asks to have the test strips from her October box, shown delivered but never received, replaced.
evidence: user_scenario:you would like the missing strips replaced
user_scenario:the tracking for your October box of test strips says it was delivered on October 9, but it never reached you

gold_actions.business_effect: A non_covered_item patient charge of 19.12 for the July refill's three denied strip units is posted and the balance rises to 83.44.

request_binding.action_semantics: Medicare denied the July claim's excess strips (CO-151) under a signed ABN, so a non-covered item charge is owed; posting it is the only write that books that liability (an appeal or adjustment would not).

discriminator.business_meaning: non-covered item charge for strips denied under a signed ABN

stage_provenance.fact: The charge is posted by this call; the denial and the ABN pre-exist.

base_preconditions.condition: A non_covered_item charge requires a liability notice signed on or before the ship date covering that item and at least those units, or on the Medicare Advantage tier the plan's organization determination denial for that item

gold_actions.business_effect: A hardship_waiver adjustment of 8.89 against the 2026-05-14 remittance is posted and the balance drops by 8.89.

request_binding.action_semantics: An approved hardship application names the posting, so the waiver is owed; a hardship_waiver balance adjustment is the write that grants it.

discriminator.business_meaning: hardship waiver on the posting named on the approved application

stage_provenance.fact: The hardship application was approved by Larkfield's financial counseling team before the call; this call posts the waiver.

base_preconditions.condition: A hardship waiver is granted only on tiers where hardship_waiver_allowed is true, only for postings named on a hardship application whose request status is approved
A small-balance write-off is made only when the whole remaining balance of the program is greater than 0.00 and no more than small_balance_writeoff_usd

gold_actions.business_effect: The customer's approved payment plan request (4 installments of 24.98) is recorded on the program.

request_binding.action_semantics: The customer asks to pay the balance in monthly payments once told the reship needs a plan; accepting a payment plan request is that act and only the customer can do it.

evidence: user_scenario:so you would like to pay it in monthly payments; when they hand the plan over to you to accept, you accept it

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The charge and the waiver are parallel prerequisites of the plan and commute: the charge reads denials, notices, medical records and hardship applications, never adjustments; the waiver's cap reads the program's balance less the postings of its recent months, and the charge, dated today, enters both terms alike, so the waiver is 8.89 before or after the charge; replaying waiver-then-charge gives the same 19.12, 8.89, 24.98 and 4 and the same terminal rows (make_id parts do not include order).
